而观众看到安少这个表情，也是一阵思考，修到七环怎么办？修到七环应该不会太拥挤了吧？

三号演播大厅的正门外，这两个声音洪亮一致的话通过厚厚的正门，直接传到了走廊之中。

李安心里就是这么试探着一问，他也不知道这个世界有没有朱丽叶，他只是对罗密欧这个名字好奇，甚至带着点惋惜。

白洛扬山前一步，周围几名身材魁梧的仆人，立刻分散四周，把江枫二人围在中间。防止他们逃走。

地老说道，随后便走进大殿之中，薛浩几人迟疑了一下便也跟了进去。

这个画风，变化得实在太突然了，王振竟然觉得有些跟不上节奏。

本来陆天想说除非经过自己的允许，连自己的亲人也不能传授，不过想到她的情况，生生憋了下去。

一想到蓝映尘白天在工地上守一天，晚上还要整理工程资料，所有的怨言都没有了，而是化做心疼暖暖而酸酸地流动着。

这些王子们，抱着胳膊，一个个兴致极高的看着，他们眼神不屑，嘴里更是说的很重。

想到这里，刘季的脸上在也没有了嬉皮笑脸，脸色瞬间变得阴沉起来，眼睛幽幽，在心中不停的为自己进行谋划。

只要一回忆起林雪瑶对他的态度，莫离的心就好似被针扎了一番，那种刺痛跟身体上受伤所带来的痛是不一样的，那种痛刻骨铭心，不能自已。

“嘿嘿嘿，可爱的昭君，这个是军事秘密了，不能说的。当然如果要说，也可以，我们避开大家，去房间说如何？”贺六浑开始一脸假笑。

“恩，我真的很替你高兴。我之前还怕你不能够成功获得积分。看来我的担心可都是多余。”莫离坐床上，跟鲁伊唠这嗑，确实之前在比赛之前莫离是很担心鲁伊的，因为她的灵修功法也不是很高。

贺六浑觉得不对劲了，这样的氛围去打战，士气低落，肯定麻烦了。

When the audience saw An Shao's expression, they also thought for a while, what should they do if they reach the seventh ring?It shouldn’t be too crowded if you reach the seventh ring road, right?

Outside the main entrance of Studio No. 3, these two loud and consistent voices passed through the thick main entrance and directly into the corridor.

Li An asked tentatively in his heart. He didn't know if there was a Juliet in this world. He was just curious about the name Romeo, and even felt a little regretful.

Bai Luoyang took a step forward, and several burly servants immediately scattered around, surrounding Jiang Feng and the two of them.Prevent them from escaping.

Di Lao said, and then walked into the main hall. Xue Hao and others followed after hesitating for a moment.

This style of painting changed so suddenly that Wang Zhen felt that he couldn't keep up with the rhythm.

Originally, Lu Tian wanted to say that he could not even teach it to his relatives without his permission, but thinking about her situation, he held it back.

When he thought of Lan Yingchen spending the whole day at the construction site and sorting out project materials at night, all his complaints disappeared and turned into warm and sour feelings.

These princes folded their arms and looked at each other with great interest. Their eyes were disdainful, and their mouths spoke very seriously.

Thinking of this, Liu Ji's face no longer had a playful smile, and his expression suddenly turned gloomy. His eyes were dim, and he kept planning for himself in his heart.

As soon as he recalled Lin Xueyao's attitude towards him, Mo Li's heart felt as if he had been pricked by a needle. The sting was different from the pain caused by physical injuries. The pain was unforgettable and could not be controlled.

"Hehehehe, lovely Zhaojun, this is a military secret and cannot be said. Of course, if you want to say it, it's okay. How about we avoid everyone and go to the room to talk?" He Liuhun started to smile.

"Well, I'm really happy for you. I was worried that you wouldn't be able to get points successfully. It seems that my worries were unnecessary." Li Moli sat on the bed and chatted with Lu Yi. Indeed, before the competition, Li Li was very worried about Lu Yi because her spiritual skills were not very high.

He Liuhun felt that something was wrong. Fighting in such an atmosphere would have low morale and would definitely lead to trouble.
